newsitem.title: BOSNIA: European Commission to donate cattle to Bosnia.
newsitem.headline: European Commission to donate cattle to Bosnia.

text.p: The European Commission will export cattle worth 1.6 million ecu to Bosnia starting in September as part of a project to encourage the return of refugees and displaced people, it said in a statement.
The commission will launch tender procedures next week for the first phase of the project which foresees the import of 560 milk cattle in September and October worth 0.7 million ecu.

"The project is important as it will enable the returning families to have a reliable, self-sustaining source of milk, but also of income, as some of the...milk produced could be put on the market," the commission said in a statement.
The commission said if the first phase was successful, it would be followed by a second stage in spring involving a larger number of cattle.
The cattle will be given to the Una Sana canton, an area in northwest Bosnia.
The commission signed a memorandum of understanding with the government of the Moslem-Croat Federation in Bosnia.

It said the memorandum was part of a wider project which also covers the Serb Republic and foresees initiatives in numerous sectors including housing, water, gas and electricity supplies, aimed at facilitating the return of refugees and displaced people.
